summary: End-to-end testing of LearnVerse (SIH platform). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/invalid), catalog, DNA, mistakes, all 5 compiler languages + stdin, chat SSE streaming, OpenAI TTS, quiz generate+submit+badges+leaderboard, friends full flow (search/request/accept/list), interview start+answer. Frontend: verified email/password login, dashboard (stat-xp=122, stat-streak=1, mastery rings, AI Time Machine with Strong/Improving/Needs revision/Repeated mistakes buckets, achievements badges grid, mistake tracking list), AI Tutor chat streaming with all 3 mode buttons + Listen/TTS button working, Code Lab running Python/JS/Java with real output, Quiz Arena full flow (5 AI questions -> submit -> result + leaderboard), Mock Interview (question 1 -> answer -> feedback + question 2), Friends search + panels render, Subjects catalog + filter, sidebar navigation, logout clears session, protected route redirects to /login when logged out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 850 lines and mixes auth, chat, TTS, DNA, quiz, friends, compiler and interview — consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability.

Local code execution in /api/compile runs untrusted user code in-container without sandbox (only length + timeout limits). Production hardening (nsjail/firejail, resource limits, no network) recommended.

google_session sets samesite='none'+secure cookie but frontend also relies on Bearer via lv_token; cookie path is fine but backend does not clear the DB session row on logout when using Bearer token (only cookie session).
quiz_generate parses model output as JSON without robust fallback — raises 500 on parse fail. Consider retry once with a stricter prompt.
Interview 'done' flag is stored but /interview/answer keeps allowing answers past count>=5 (no 400). Minor.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ created during registration/friends tests. TEST_bfs mistake added to seed user via mistakes API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 review-request features verified working. Compiler executes locally (python3/node/gcc/g++/javac). Chat uses SSE, TTS returns /api/tts/<key>.mp3. Auth uses Bearer token in lv_token localStorage. Use pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression.
